blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) aims to generalize from a single source domain to unseen domains under distribution shifts. Existing efforts mainly focus on simulating unseen domains or suppressing domain-specific factors. However, they largely overlook the intrinsic generalization capability embedded in Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). In this work, we show that unconstrained fine-tuning disrupts the geometric structure of pre-trained representations, which encodes domain-invariant semantics. Motivated by this, we propose Geometric-Invariance Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a geometric-aware fine-tuning method for VFMs. Specifically, we introduce a series of learnable Householder reflections to the pre-trained weights to encourage geometry-consistent adaptation under domain shift. In addition, we propose a lightweight channel-wise scaling to facilitate effective task-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches on two S-DGOD benchmarks. Notably, by introducing fewer than 1% additional trainable parameters into the frozen backbone, the proposed method achieves improvements of +7.9% and +2.9% in mPC over the previous SOTA on the Cityscapes-C and Diverse Weather Dataset, respectively. This finding highlights that preserving representation geometry is crucial for robust cross-domain generalization, establishing GIFT as a principled and efficient solution to domain shift.
blocks.zh: 单域通用对象检测(S-DGOD)旨在从一个单一源域到分布相变时所未见域的通用. 现有努力主要侧重于模拟看不见的领域或压制特定领域的因素。 然而,它们在很大程度上忽略了Vision Foundation Models(VFMs)中固有的通俗化能力. 在这部作品中,我们显示不受约束的微调会打乱了被事先训练的表示的几何结构,它编码了域-变量语义. 以此为动机,我们提议了几何-内变精通法(GIFT),即VFM的几何-知微调法. 具体地说,我们引入了一系列可学习的住户反思,对预先训练的权重进行反思,以鼓励在域移下进行几何-相容的适应. 此外,我们建议采用轻量级的频道,以便利针对具体任务的有效适应。 广泛的实验表明,打击人口贩运全球举措在两个S-DGOD基准方面一直比最先进的方法要好。 值得注意的是,通过在被冻结的主干线中引入不到1%的额外可训练参数,拟议的方法使mPC的改进率分别达到+7.9%和+2.9%,而之前的Cityscapes-C和diversity Weather Datas集的SOTA则有所改进。 这一结论突出表明,保持代表性几何对强有力的跨域通论至关重要,它把全球打击人口贩运举措确立为有原则和有效的域转移解决方案。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) Wu and Deng (2022) aims to learn from a single source domain while generalizing to diverse unseen target domains.
Traditional CNN-based methods primarily attempt to simulate domain diversity within a single source domain Xu et al. (2025b) or explicitly disentangle domain-invariant and domain-specific features Wu and Deng (2022) . Despite their effectiveness, these methods are generally built on CNN backbones such as ResNet He et al. (2016) and pre-trained on medium-scale datasets (e.g., ImageNet Deng et al. (2009) ). Such constraints may limit representation capacity and hinder generalization to diverse unseen domains.

以CNN为基础的传统方法主要尝试在单一源域徐等人(2025b)内模拟域多样性,或明确分解域-变量和域特定特征吴和邓(2022). 尽管这些方法是有效的,但这些方法一般建立在CNN主干线上,如ResNet He等人(2016年),并在中尺度数据集(如ImageNet Deng等人(2009年))上进行预训. 这种限制可能限制代表能力,并阻碍对各种看不见领域的概括。

blocks.en:
Recently, leveraging powerful Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), such as DINO Caron et al. (2021) ; Oquab et al. (2023) ; Siméoni et al. (2025) , EVA Fang et al. (2023) ; Fang et al. (2024) , and SAM Kirillov et al. (2023) ; Ravi et al. (2024) ; Carion et al. (2025) , has become an effective strategy to overcome performance bottlenecks. With large-scale pre-training and strong representation capacity, these models have significantly advanced various vision tasks Abou Baker et al. (2024) ; Yun et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2025) .
A mainstream approach to exploiting these VFMs is Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) Han et al. (2024) , which adapts the pre-trained model by updating only a small subset of parameters through lightweight modules such as prompts Jiang et al. (2024) , adapters Chen et al. (2022) , or low-rank adaptations (LoRA) Hu et al. (2022) .
However, existing PEFT-based methods mainly focus on effectively adapting VFMs to downstream tasks. In the context of S-DGOD, the lack of multi-source data makes models prone to overfitting on source-specific statistics. Moreover, current PEFT-based S-DGOD methods largely follow conventional strategies from CNN-based methods, often overlooking the intrinsic generalization ability of VFMs, which is especially important under limited source diversity.

blocks.en: We perform two experiments to show that unconstrained fine-tuning can disrupt the geometric structure of pre-trained representations, leading to degraded generalization on unseen target domains. By explicitly preserving this structure, our method improves cross-domain generalization.

blocks.en:
Building on these insights, we propose G eometric- I nvariance F ine- T uning ( GIFT ) for S-DGOD, which incorporates two key innovations.
First, we preserve the geometric structure of pre-trained representations by introducing a series of Householder reflections Yuan et al. (2024) , which ensure that the parameter space is transformed without altering its geometry.
Second, we introduce a lightweight channel-wise scaling to the transformed weights to adapt task-specific features. Built on the geometric-preserving fine-tuning, this simple scaling yields noticeable gains in downstream object detection tasks, further highlighting the importance of maintaining the pre-trained geometric structure during fine-tuning.
In summary, the main contributions of this paper are as follows:

第二,我们引入了轻量级通道对变换重量的缩放,以适应特定任务的特点. 这种简单的缩放在几何保存微调的基础上,在下游物体探测任务中产生显著的增益,进一步凸显了在微调期间保持预先训练的几何结构的重要性.
概括地说,本文件的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We are the first to investigate fine-tuning pre-trained VFMs for S-DGOD from a geometric perspective, revealing that unconstrained updates can distort representations and impair cross-domain generalization. • We propose GIFT , a geometric-invariance fine-tuning method that preserves the intrinsic geometry of pre-trained representations, improving cross-domain generalization and enabling effective task-specific adaptation. • Extensive experiments on two S-DGOD benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of GIFT, achieving +7.9% and +2.9% mPC improvements over the previous SOTA on Cityscapes-C and Diverse Weather, respectively.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Most S-DGOD methods improve generalization either by simulating domain diversity through augmentation/diversification Xu et al. (2025b) ; Danish et al. (2024) ; Lee et al. (2024) , or by learning domain-invariant representations Lin et al. (2021) ; Wu and Deng (2022) ; Liu et al. (2024) . More recently, CLIP-based methods Radford et al. (2021) ; Vidit et al. (2023) ; Xu et al. (2025a) ; Yu et al. (2026) have shown promising results, but most methods still rely on full-parameter fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 大多数S-DGOD方法通过增强/分散化Xu等人(2025b),丹麦人等人(2024),李等人(2024),或者通过学习域-不变量代表Lin等人(2021),吴和邓(2022),刘等人(2024)来模拟域多样性,来改进泛化. 最近,基于CLIP的方法Radford等人(2021);Vidit等人(2023);徐等人(2025a); Yu等人(2026年)已经显示出有希望的结果,但大多数方法仍然依赖于全参数的微调.

blocks.en:
Leveraging the power of large pre-trained Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), PEFT Han et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2026) has emerged as a promising direction for vision tasks Abou Baker et al. (2024) ; Szatkowski et al. (2024) ; Zheng et al. (2026) .
However, S-DGOD under this paradigm remains largely underexplored, with only a few recent attempts Li et al. (2025) ; Yun et al. (2025) ; Jiang et al. (2025a) . Specifically, Cauvis Li et al. (2025) adopts DINOv2 Oquab et al. (2023) as a backbone and employs causal intervention to suppress spurious domain-specific correlations. Similarly, SoMA Yun et al. (2025) applies Singular Value Decomposition to separate domain-specific dominant components from domain-invariant semantic components.
However, these methods overlook the intrinsic generalization ability of VFMs. In this work, we study PEFT-based S-DGOD from the perspective of the geometric structure of pre-trained representations. We reveal that maintaining a stable representation geometry is more critical for generalization than explicitly removing domain-specific features.
blocks.zh:
利用经过预先培训的大型展望基金会模型、PEFT的力量 Han等人(2024年); 许等人(2026年) 逐渐成为愿景任务的有希望方向 Abou Baker等人(2024年); Szatkowski等人(2024年); Zheng等人(2026年).
然而,在这个范式下,S-DGOD在很大程度上仍然未得到充分探讨,最近仅有几起尝试Li等人(2025年);Yun等人(2025年);Jiang等人(2025年a). 具体来说,Cauvis Li等人(2025年)采用DINOv2 Oquab等人(2023年)作为骨干,并采用因果干预来压制假域特定关联. 同样,索马尼亚州 云等论. (2025)应用Singular Value解析法将特定域的主导组件与域-invariant语义组件分离.
然而,这些方法忽略了VFM的内在通用能力. 在这项工作中,我们从预训表达的几何结构的角度研究基于PEFT的S-DGOD. 我们揭示,保持稳定的表达几何对概括性比明确去除特定领域特征更为关键.

blocks.en:
Geometric invariance is crucial for representation learning. Early works such as SphereFace Liu et al. (2017) and ArcFace Deng et al. (2019) established this foundation by projecting features onto a hypersphere and optimizing angular margins, showing that angular distributions are more discriminative and robust.
In domain-shift learning, AIDGN Jin et al. (2022) and PAID Wang et al. (2025) interpret angular structures as domain-invariant semantic cues. However, AIDGN necessitates inter-domain contrastive signals to identify invariant components, whereas PAID relies on access to target-domain data for adaptation.
Recently, Householder Transformations Yuan et al. (2024) ; Dong et al. (2024) have been proposed to preserve the geometric structure of the learnable feature space through orthogonal adaptations. However, they aim to improve adaptation efficiency rather than enhance cross-domain generalization. Building on these insights, this work
leverages geometric-preserving fine-tuning to tackle S-DGOD, enabling robust localization and recognition in unseen target domains.

Importantly, the orthogonal rotation branch primarily preserves relational geometric structure, such as pairwise angular relationships and relative orientations between pretrained weight vectors.
In contrast, the channel-level scaling components intentionally modify feature magnitudes and channel importance to enable task-specific adaptation. Therefore, the proposed method should be viewed as preserving stable structural relations while allowing controlled feature reweighting, rather than enforcing strict isometry during adaptation.

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准

blocks.en: Following existing S-DGOD methods Zoph et al. (2020) ; Lee et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2025) , we evaluate our method on two benchmarks: the Diverse Weather Dataset (DWD) Wu and Deng (2022) and Cityscapes-C Michaelis et al. (2019) . DWD comprises five scenarios: Daytime-Sunny (DS.), Daytime-Foggy (DF.), Dusk-Rainy (DR.), Night-Rainy (NR.), and Night-Sunny (NS.). Cityscapes-C is a benchmark for evaluating detection robustness under common corruptions. It generates 15 corruption types with 5 severity levels.
blocks.zh: 遵循现有的S-DGOD方法Zoph等人(2020年);Lee等人(2024年);Li等人(2025年),我们用两个基准来评价我们的方法:DWD 吴和Deng(2022年)和Cityscapes-C Michaelis等人(2019年)。 DWD包含5种情景:日间-Sunny(DS.),日间-Fogy(DF.),Dusk-Rainy(DR.),夜光(NR.)和夜光(NS.). 城市景观-C是评价常见腐败下侦测力度的基准。 它产生了15种严重程度为5级的腐败。

blocks.en: For evaluation, we report mean Average Precision (mAP 50 ) to measure detection performance and mean Performance under Corruption (mPC) to evaluate robustness. For DWD Wu and Deng (2022) , mPC is computed as the average mAP over four weather conditions, while for Cityscapes-C Michaelis et al. (2019) , it averages mAP 50 across all corruption types and severity levels.
blocks.zh: 就评价而言,我们报告是指衡量发现业绩的平均精确度(mAP 50),以及评价稳健性的腐败下的平均绩效。 对DWD Wu和Deng(2022年)来说,mPC是按四个天气条件下的平均mAP计算的,而对于Cityscapes-C Michaelis等人(2019年)来说,它在所有腐败类型和严重程度上的平均mAP 50。

blocks.en: We use DINOv2-Large Oquab et al. (2023) as the default VFM, while results with other VFMs are reported in Appendix A.3 . For DWD, we employ Faster R-CNN Ren et al. (2016) and DINO Zhang et al. (2022) (a DETR-based detector) as detection heads, respectively. For Cityscapes-C, Faster R-CNN is used as the detection head. All models are trained for 12 epochs using the AdamW optimizer with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 and β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 , a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and a batch size of 2. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we revisit Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) from the perspective of representation geometry in Vision Foundation Models. We show that unconstrained fine-tuning disrupts pre-trained geometric structures, undermining domain-invariant generalization. To address this, we propose Geometric-Invariance Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a simple yet principled method that preserves representation geometry while enabling effective task adaptation. Experiments on two S-DGOD benchmarks demonstrate that GIFT consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods, achieving significant performance gains with fewer than 1% additional trainable parameters. These results highlight the importance of preserving pre-trained representation geometry for robust domain generalization and suggest a promising direction for extending GIFT to broader vision tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们从视觉基础模型中的代表几何学的角度重新审视单一领域通用物体探测(S-DGOD). 我们显示,不受约束的微调会破坏预先训练的几何结构,破坏域-不变量的泛化. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用几何-Invariance Fine-Tuning(GIFT),这是一种简单但有原则的方法,既能保留代表性几何,又能有效适应任务。 对S-DGOD两个基准的实验表明,GIFT始终超越最先进的方法,取得了显著的性能收益,增加了不到1%的可训练参数. 这些成果突出表明,必须保留经过预先培训的表达几何方法,以便强有力地概括领域,并为将打击人口贩运全球举措扩大到更广泛的愿景任务提出一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: A.1 Position of the HR Matrices within the Transformer Blocks.
blocks.zh: A.1 " 变形金刚石 " 中人力资源矩阵的位置。

blocks.en: In our proposed method, we introduce a learnable rotation matrix 𝑹 \bm{R} , defined as the product of r r Householder Reflection (HR) matrices, and integrate it into the frozen Transformer blocks. We now investigate the effect of the insertion position of the HR matrices within the Transformer blocks on the S-DGOD task. Specifically, we conduct experiments on the QKV projection layer ( Q ​ K ​ V QKV ), the output projection layer ( O ​ u ​ t ​ p ​ u ​ t Output ) and the feed-forward network (MLP layer, F ​ F ​ N FFN ) within the DINOv2 Transformer blocks.
blocks.zh: 在我们提议的方法中,我们引入一个可学习的旋转矩阵R\bm{R},定义为r r 家庭反射矩阵(HR)的产物,并将其整合到冷冻变形器块中. 我们现在调查变形板块内人力资源矩阵的插入位置对S-DGOD任务的影响。 具体来说,我们在DINov2变压器块内的QKV投影层(QK V QKV),输出投影层(O u t p u t 输出)和向导网络(MLP层,F F F N FFN)进行实验.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 8 , inserting HR matrices only into the Q ​ K ​ V QKV projection yields a substantial improvement over the baseline, increasing the mPC from 54.1% to 58.9% (first and second rows). This configuration consistently improves performance across all domains, indicating that enhancing the Q ​ K ​ V QKV projections strengthens the robustness of attention representations.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,仅在QK V QKV预测中插入人力资源矩阵,比基线大有改进,mPC从54.1%增加到58.9%(第一和第二行)。 这种配置持续改善所有领域的业绩,表明加强QK V QKV预测可加强关注表达的稳健性.

blocks.en: Further inserting HR matrices into both the Q ​ K ​ V QKV and O ​ u ​ t ​ p ​ u ​ t Output projection layers leads to the best overall performance, achieving the highest mPC of 59.4% and the best mAP (62.7%). In contrast, adding HR matrices to the F ​ F ​ N FFN layer does not bring further gains and slightly degrades performance (mPC drops to 58.7%). This observation indicates that robustness improvements mainly originate from the attention layers rather than the feed-forward network. Consequently, we adopt the Q ​ K ​ V QKV + O ​ u ​ t ​ p ​ u ​ t Output configuration as our default setting.
blocks.zh: 进一步将人力资源矩阵插入QK V QKV和O u t p u t 输出投影层,使总体性能最佳,实现最高的mPC59.4%和最佳mAP(62.7%). 相比之下,在F F N FFN 层中加入人力资源矩阵不会带来进一步的增益,并且会略微降低性能(mPC下降至58.7%). 这一观察表明,稳健性改善主要源于关注层,而不是向导网络。 因此,我们将QK V QKV + O u t p u t 输出配置作为我们的默认设置.

blocks.en: A.3 Performance across Different VFMs.
blocks.zh: A.3 不同VFM的性能。

blocks.en: We further validate the proposed method using three different VFMs, i.e. , EVA02-Large [ 15 , 14 ] , SAM-Huge [ 28 ] , and DINOv2-Large [ 37 ] . As shown in Table 10 , our method achieves strong performance across all three VFM backbones, demonstrating strong generalization. Specifically, our method achieves 48.9% mPC on the EVA02 [ 14 ] backbone, surpassing frozen EVA02 by a large margin (+8.9%). Moreover, it brings a +5.3% improvement on the DINOv2 [ 37 ] backbone and achieves a satisfactory performance (49.7% mPC) on SAM [ 28 ] . In addition, our method still has significant advantages over the current best method Cauvis [ 30 ] , achieving improvements of +1.4%, +0.4%, and +1.9% on EVA02, SAM and DINOv2 backbones, respectively. These results indicate that our method enhances the performance of different VFMs and provides stable improvements across diverse weather conditions, highlighting its effectiveness for S-DGOD tasks.

blocks.en: For more details on the Feature Correlation Analysis in Section 4.3 , we extract object-level features from the penultimate layer of the classification head and group them according to their object categories. Given an input image, the Transformer backbone produces a sequence of patch tokens. We then compute the average cosine similarity between class-wise features from the clean and corrupted domains to construct the feature correlation matrix.
blocks.zh: 关于第4.3节中的地物关联分析的更多细节,我们从分类头的倒数第二层提取对象级特征,并按其对象类别分组. 由于一个输入图像,变形器主干产生一系列的补丁符号. 然后我们计算从干净和腐败域中分级的特征之间的平均余弦相似性,以构建特征相关性矩阵。

blocks.zh: 如表11所示,在各种天气引起的域位变化中,拟议方法在四个未见目标域中一贯取得最佳业绩。 特别是,打击人口贩运全球倡议达到的最高mPC值为57.0%,超过了以前的SOTA方法,Cauvis [30] ,提高了2.9%,超过了基线(Frozen Dinov2 [37],更快的R-CNN [41]),提高了4.9%。 此外,打击人口贩运全球举措显示,相对于传统的S-DGOD方法,如UFR[34](+23.8%)、PDD[31](+24.4%)和G-NAS[52](+23.5%)而言,绩效差很大,这表明拟议的基于VFM的微调战略有效地解决了S-DGOD的主要瓶颈。

blocks.en: Notably, even when only geometric preservation is applied, the model still outperforms previous methods. Across the four unseen domains, it improves over the baseline by 4.5%, 3.8%, 3.2%, and 5.5%, and surpasses the SOTA method Cauvis [ 30 ] by 2.8%, 1.5%, 2.5%, and 2.6%, highlighting the effectiveness of preserving the geometric structure of pre-trained representations.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,即使只应用几何保存法,该模型仍然比以前的方法好。 在四个看不见的领域,它比基线提高了4.5%、3.8%、3.2%和5.5%,超过了SOTA方法Cauvis[30],增加了2.8%、1.5%、2.5%和2.6%,突出了保留预先培训的表述的几何结构的有效性。

blocks.en: C.2 Results on Daytime-Sunny.
blocks.zh: C.2 Daytime-Sunny的成绩.

blocks.en: We report the detection results on the source domain of DWD [ 51 ] . As shown in Table 12 , our method significantly outperforms traditional S-DGOD methods in terms of mAP. For example, when using the same detector, Faster R-CNN [ 41 ] , our method achieves improvements of +15.3% over UFR [ 34 ] (from 58.6% to 73.9%) and +21.4% over ClipGap [ 47 ] (52.5% vs. 73.9%). Surprisingly, our method with Faster R-CNN detector is even superior to Cauvis [ 30 ] , which uses a DETR-based detector (73.9% vs. 73.7%). Moreover, when using a DETR-based detector, our method achieves a new state-of-the-art result of 76% in mAP, surpassing Cauvis by 2.3%, and achieves the best performance in 6 out of the 7 categories.
blocks.zh: 我们报告DWD源域的检测结果 [51]. 如表12所示,我们的方法在mAP方面大大超过传统的S-DGOD方法。 例如,当使用同一探测器,即更快的R-CNN[41]时,我们的方法比UFR[34](从58.6%提高到73.9%)和比ClipGap[47](52.5%对73.9%)提高15.3%,比ClipGap(52.5%对73.9%)提高21.4%。 令人惊讶的是,我们使用更快的R-CNN探测器的方法甚至优于Cauvis [30],它使用基于DETR的探测器(73.9%对73.7%). 此外,在使用基于DETR的探测器时,我们的方法在mAP中取得了76%的全新先进结果,超过了Cauvis的2.3%,并在7个类别中的6个类别中取得了最佳表现.

blocks.en: Daytime-Foggy. Our DETR-based model (Ours (D)) achieves the best overall performance with 58.3% mAP, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art method Cauvis [ 30 ] by +1.8% mAP. Specifically, our method consistently improves most object categories, including Bus (55.0% vs. 50.7%), Bike (46.1% vs. 43.8%), Motor (51.7% vs. 50.5%), Person (68.8% vs. 67.4%), and Rider (64.3% vs. 61.9%). Notably, our Faster R-CNN-based version (Ours (F)) also performs competitively, particularly in the Truck category, where it achieves the highest accuracy of 49.1%. Despite the reduced visibility caused by fog, our method still demonstrates strong robustness.
blocks.zh: 日间福吉. 我们基于DETR的模型(Ours (D))以58.3%的mAP实现了最佳的整体性能,以+1.8%的mAP超过了之前最先进的方法Cauvis [30]. 具体而言,我们的方法不断改进大多数物体类别,包括公共汽车(55.0%对50.7%)、自行车(46.1%对43.8%)、汽车(51.7%对50.5%)、个人(68.8%对67.4%)和骑车(64.3%对61.9%)。 值得注意的是,我们更快的基于R-CNN的版本(我们的(F))也具有竞争力,特别是在卡车类别中,其精度最高,达到49.1%。 尽管雾导致可见度下降,但我们的方法仍然显示出强烈的强力。

blocks.en: Dusk-Rainy. Our method achieves 65.9% mAP, outperforming Cauvis [ 30 ] by +1.3% mAP. It is worth noting that Ours (F) exhibits exceptional performance in the Car category, reaching 87.1% mAP, and the Rider category at 60.2%. These results suggest that our framework effectively preserves geometric structure even when visual clarity is compromised by rain artifacts and low-light conditions during dusk.
blocks.zh: 黄昏瑞尼. 我们的方法实现了65.9%的mAP,以+1.3%的mAP的成绩优于Cauvis[30]. 值得注意的是,Ours(F)在汽车类别中表现优异,达到87.1%的mAP,骑手类别为60.2%。 这些结果表明,我们的框架有效地维护了几何结构,即使视觉清晰度受到雨品和黄昏期间低光线条件的影响。

blocks.en: Night-Rainy. The Night-Rainy domain is the most challenging scenario due to extremely low illumination and rain artifacts. Although all models experience performance degradation, Ours (D) maintains a clear lead with 49.9% mAP. In particular, the improvement on Bike (from 32.4% to 38.5%, +6.1% mAP) demonstrates the effectiveness of our method in detecting small objects under severe visual degradation.
blocks.zh: 夜来瑞尼. 夜光域是最具挑战性的场景,因为照明和雨品极低. 虽然所有的模型都经历了性能退化,但Ours(D)以49.9%的mAP保持明显的领先. 特别是,自行车的改进(从32.4%提高到38.5%,+6.1% mAP)证明了我们在严重视觉退化下探测小物体的方法的有效性.

blocks.en: Night-Sunny. Our models continue to dominate the results under Night-Sunny conditions. Ours (D) achieves the highest mAP of 63.3%, showing superior performance in the Person (72.6%) and Bike (59.3%) categories. These results demonstrate that our method effectively handles object appearance variations caused by strong illumination contrast in nighttime scenes.
blocks.zh: 夜苏尼. 我们的模特在夜香条件下 继续主导着结果 我们的(D)实现了63.3%的最高mAP,在人物(72.6%)和自行车(59.3%)类别中表现优异。 这些结果显示,我们的方法有效地处理了夜间场景中强烈的光照对比导致的物体外观变化.

blocks.en: Overall, the consistent improvements across all domains demonstrate that our method effectively enhances cross-domain robustness and generalization under diverse adverse weather and illumination conditions.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,所有领域的持续改进表明,我们的方法在各种不利天气和照明条件下,有效地增强了跨域强度和普遍性。

blocks.en: Fig. 10 and Table 14 present a detailed comparison between our method and Cauvis [ 30 ] on the Cityscapes-C [ 35 ] dataset across 5 severity levels. As shown in Fig. 10 , our method consistently outperforms Cauvis across almost all corruption types and severity levels. Specifically, our method achieves higher mAP under both Noise-based corruptions (e.g., Gaussian, Shot, and Impulse) and Blur-based corruptions (e.g., Defocus, Glass, Motion, and Zoom), demonstrating stronger robustness to various perturbations.
blocks.zh: 图10和表14详细比较了我们的方法和Cauvis在Cityscapes-C[35]数据集上的5个重度数据。 如图10所示,我们的方法在几乎所有腐败类型和严重程度上都一直比Cauvis好。 具体地说,我们的方法在噪声腐败(如高森、Shot和Impulse)和模糊腐败(如DeFocus、Glass、Motion和Zoom)下都实现了更高的mAP,显示了对各种干扰的强烈性。

blocks.en: As the corruption severity increases from Level-1 to Level-5, the performance of both methods gradually decreases. However, our method exhibits a slower degradation trend compared to Cauvis. For instance, under severe corruptions such as Level-5, our method still maintains noticeably higher results across most corruption types. Moreover, as shown in Table 14 , our method achieves an excellent performance (43.5% in mPC) compared with Cauvis (35.6%), showing an overall improvement of +7.9%. These results demonstrate that our method substantially improves the robustness of the model against diverse corruptions.
blocks.zh: 随着腐败的严重程度从1级提高到5级,这两种方法的性能都逐渐下降. 然而,与考维斯相比,我们的方法呈现出较缓慢的退化趋势。 例如,在诸如第5级等严重腐败的情况下,我们的方法在大多数腐败类型中仍然明显保持较高的结果。 此外,如表14所示,我们的方法取得了优异的业绩(mPC为43.5%),而Cauvis为35.6%,显示总体改善为+7.9%。 这些结果表明,我们的方法大大提高了打击各种腐败模式的稳健性。

blocks.en: Daytime-Foggy. In foggy conditions characterized by low contrast and obscured details, our method demonstrates superior capability in identifying distant cars and trucks that are often incorrectly detected by ClipGap [ 47 ] and the Baseline. Moreover, the Baseline and Cauvis [ 30 ] often produce inaccurate bounding boxes due to the degraded visibility while our model remains well aligned with the ground truth (GT).
blocks.zh: 日间福吉. 在低对比度和模糊细节的雾化条件下,我们的方法显示,在识别ClipGap[47]和基线常常不正确检测到的远方汽车和卡车方面,能力较强。 此外,基线和Cauvis[30]往往由于能见度下降而产生不准确的边框,而我们的模型仍然与地面真理完全一致。

blocks.en: Dusk-Rainy. In this scenario, other models frequently produce incomplete detections or inaccurate localization due to reduced visibility and illumination variations. In contrast, our method accurately detects persons and trucks despite the visual noise caused by rain streaks, indicating improved robustness to simultaneous illumination and weather variations.
blocks.zh: 黄昏瑞尼. 在这种假想中,由于能见度降低和照明变异,其他模型经常产生不完全的检测或不准确的本地化. 与此相反,我们的方法精确地探测到人和卡车,尽管雨量引起视觉噪音,这表明在同时发生照明和天气变化时强度有所提高。

blocks.en: Night-Rainy. In this setting, most other methods suffer from severe detection failures. For instance, ClipGap [ 47 ] , Baseline and Cauvis [ 30 ] mistakenly detect cars as trucks. In contrast, our model shows remarkable resilience against glare from streetlights and headlights. These results demonstrate that the proposed method can better preserve geometric structure even under extreme nighttime weather conditions.
blocks.zh: 夜来瑞尼. 在这种背景下,大多数其他方法都遇到了严重的检测失败. 例如,ClipGap[47],基线和Cauvis[30]错误地检测汽车为卡车. 反之,我们的模型显示出了对街道灯光和前灯光的显著抗御力。 这些结果表明,拟议的方法即使在极端的夜间天气条件下也能更好地保存几何结构。

blocks.en: Night-Sunny. Although this domain does not contain rain or fog, extremely low illumination still poses significant challenges for object detection. Many other methods fail to detect small cars or distant trucks while our predictions are nearly indistinguishable from the GT.
blocks.zh: 夜苏尼. 尽管这个域并不包含雨或雾,但极低的照明度仍然对物体检测构成重大挑战. 许多其他方法都未能探测到小型汽车或远方卡车,而我们的预测与GT几乎无法区分.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitation
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en:
First, when the pre-trained geometry is not well aligned with the downstream task, the relative improvement may be smaller than that observed in natural RGB driving scenarios,
such as infrared or remote sensing images that differ substantially from natural-image pretraining data. Second, although GIFT reduces the number of trainable parameters and improves adaptation efficiency, its reliance on large-scale pre-trained VFMs still requires considerable GPU memory. In addition, this work focuses on a fixed category set. Its effectiveness under open-vocabulary domain generalization, where the detector needs to generalize to both unseen domains and novel categories, remains unexplored. Extending the proposed framework to open-vocabulary domain generalization is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
第一,当预训几何与下游任务不完全一致时,相对改进可能比自然RGB驱动情景中观察到的要小,
诸如红外线或遥感图像,这些图像与自然图像预训练数据有很大不同。 第二,虽然GIFT减少了可训练参数的数量,提高了适应效率,但其对大规模预训VFM的依赖仍需要相当的GPU内存. 此外,这项工作还侧重于一套固定类别。 它在开放-vocabulary域泛化下的有效性,即探测器需要泛化到隐形域和新类别,但仍未加以探讨。 将拟议框架扩展至开放-省域泛化是未来工作的一个重要方向。
